user.title: Find your Mac
user.description: Charmling is usually found on its own. If it was not, type the Mac's address. The port is shown in Charmling's Home Assistant pane.

data_description.host: The Mac's IP address or Bonjour name (abis-macbook-pro.local).
data_description.port: Charmling's pane shows it; 41417 unless that port was taken.

pair.title: Pair with Charmling on {name}
pair.description: On the Mac, open Charmling's menu → 🏠 Home Assistant… and type the six digits it shows. ({host})

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again with Charmling on {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Charmling on the Mac ({host}) no longer accepts this Home Assistant's pairing — it was unpaired there, or the app was reinstalled. Open Charmling's menu → 🏠 Home Assistant… and type the six digits it shows.

reconfigure.title: Where is {name} now?
reconfigure.description: The Mac's new address. The existing pairing is kept if the Mac still accepts it; otherwise you will be asked for a code.

data_description.host: The Mac's IP address or Bonjour name.

error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. Open the pane on the Mac again; it shows a fresh one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Charmling on the Mac. Is the app running, and is the Mac on this network?
error.different_mac: That address belongs to a different Mac. Add it as a new device instead.
error.no_url: Home Assistant does not know its own address on this network. Set the internal URL in Settings → System → Network, then try again.

abort.already_in_progress: This Mac is already being paired.

options.done: Done — a flick and a bead
options.emergency: Emergency — the bark, hush or no hush

say.name: Say
say.description: Have whatever is on the cord say a line, its own way: the charm's ritual and the line, or the dog delivering it in person.

device_id.name: Mac
device_id.description: Which Mac. Optional when only one is paired.

message.name: Message
message.description: The line, shown above the charm or the dog.

category.name: Category
category.description: How it is said: arrival, alert, done, ambient, or emergency.

water.name: Water
water.description: Tend the Garden the way the menu does, once per day; confetti if it grew. For a real plant's moisture sensor.

device_id.name: Mac
device_id.description: Which Mac. Optional when only one is paired.

do.name: Do
do.description: Ask the dog, or the charm, to do something.

device_id.name: Mac
device_id.description: Which Mac. Optional when only one is paired.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: For a focus session: how long. 25 if left out.

no_mac.message: No Mac is paired with Charmling.

pick_a_mac.message: More than one Mac is paired; choose one as the target.

not_a_mac.message: None of the targeted devices is a Charmling Mac.

unpaired.message: Charmling on {name} no longer accepts this pairing. Pair again from Settings → Devices & services.

unreachable.message: Charmling on {name} could not be reached ({what}): {error}

refused.message: Charmling on {name} cannot do that right now ({what}): there is no dog on the cord, or it is away.
